description: Print a page and write with a pencil: labels, sentences and short stories about pictures.

tier.name: Starting support

A.studentGoal: I can write a label or one sentence about a picture.

info.headline: I can write a label or one sentence about a picture.
info.summary: Labels and one sentence with a word bank.
canDo: I can write a label or one sentence about a picture.

activities.title: Label the Garden
activities.directions: Print your page. Write a word next to three things in the garden picture.
activities.directionsEs: Imprime tu página. Escribe una palabra junto a tres cosas del dibujo del huerto.
activities.prompt: Label three things in the garden.
writeFor: I spelled them with the word bank.
successCriteria: I spelled them with the word bank.
vocabulary: a word that names something in a picture
rótulo: palabra que nombra algo en un dibujo
a wall made of boards around a place
cerca: pared de tablas alrededor de un lugar
activities.correct: Your labels name things in the picture.
activities.hint: Use the sentence starter and the word bank. You can draw first, then write.
activities.support: Use the sentence starter and the word bank. You can draw first, then write.
activities.extension: Add a picture and one more sentence.

teacher.use: Paper and pencil. Print the page; the child draws or writes, then reads it to a grown-up; writing labels for a picture.
teacher.lower: The child dictates and the adult writes; the child traces or copies one word.
teacher.onLevel: The child writes with the sentence starter and word bank.
teacher.challenge: Add a second sentence that tells why or what happened next.
teacher.noTech: This task is already on paper. Read the prompt aloud and point to the word bank.
teacher.prompt: Read your sentence to me. Which word bank word did you use?

activities.prompt: What book do you like? Why?
writeFor: I wrote a reason with because.
activities.responsePlaceholder: I like ___. I like it because ___.
successCriteria: I wrote a reason with because.
